bagPolicy.summary: One clear bag up to 12" x 6" x 12" or a one gallon clear Ziploc style bag is allowed, plus a small purse up to 4.5" x 6.5". No bag check.
allowed: One clear PVC or vinyl bag up to 12" x 6" x 12"
One gallon clear Ziploc style bag
Small purse or wallet up to 4.5" x 6.5"
Medical bags after search and tagging
Diaper bags when a child is present, after search
Blankets and extra clothing carried loosely or in an approved clear bag
prohibited: Purses or wallets larger than 4.5" x 6.5"
Non-clear bags inside a clear bag
Any bag larger than the allowed size
Outside lawn chairs at Live Nation shows
bagPolicy.note: Medical bags do not need to be clear; tell security at the gate. The amphitheater does not check or store prohibited bags, so leave them in your car or hotel.

parking.note: Parking availability, access routes, and pricing at Empower Federal Credit Union Amphitheater can vary by event. Review the linked official information and reserve in advance when that option is offered.

rideshare.note: View arrival path to Drop Off/Pick Up in the Pink Lot from 690W. Drop Off / Pick Up & Rideshares

concessions.note: Food and beverage availability at Empower Federal Credit Union Amphitheater varies by event and operating setup. Review the linked official guest information before arrival.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Current official guidance confirms that accessibility arrangements are handled by Empower Federal Credit Union Amphitheater, but event-specific services may require advance coordination. Contact the venue before purchasing if you need accessible seating, mobility assistance, interpreting, assistive-listening support, or another accommodation.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: A venue-wide re-entry rule was not confirmed in Empower Federal Credit Union Amphitheater's current published guidance. Treat exit as final unless event staff explicitly confirms re-entry before you leave.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Current official guidance does not publish one universal will-call schedule for every event at Empower Federal Credit Union Amphitheater. Use the delivery instructions in the official ticket order and confirm event-day box-office details before traveling to the venue.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Entrance assignments and door times are event-specific at Empower Federal Credit Union Amphitheater. Use the entrance shown on the official event page or ticket, arrive early for screening, and follow on-site signage.
